MINE.TITLE: My documents
MINE.INTRO: The documents your company asked you to read and accept. Each one has its code, its current version and the deadline to accept it.
MINE.READ_ONLY: You only need to read it.
MINE.EMPTY_TITLE: You have no documents assigned yet
MINE.EMPTY_BODY: When your company administrator assigns you one, it will show up here with its deadline to accept it.
MINE.EMPTY_FILTERED_BODY: Try another code or name, or clear the filters.

READER.MISSING_TITLE: This document is not assigned to you
READER.MISSING_BODY: It may no longer be assigned to you, or the link may be wrong. Check your list of documents.
READER.ACCEPT_BODY: By accepting, it is recorded that you read {{code}}, version {{number}}, with the date and the fingerprint of the file. It cannot be undone.
READER.ACCEPT_LATE: The deadline has passed: you can still accept it, and it will be recorded as late.
READER.ACCEPTED_BODY: You accepted version {{number}} on {{date}}. If a new version is published, we will ask you to accept it again.
READER.NOT_REQUIRED_BODY: This document does not require acceptance: you only need to read it.
READER.CONFIRM_BODY: It will be recorded with your name, the date and the fingerprint of the file. An acceptance cannot be edited or deleted.
READER.LINK_EXPIRES: The link to the file expires in 5 minutes: if it expires while you read, open it again.
READER.DOWNLOAD_ONLY_TITLE: This file is read by downloading it
READER.DOWNLOAD_ONLY_BODY: {{name}} cannot be shown on screen. Download it to read it and, when you finish, accept the document.
READER.VIEWER_ERROR: We could not open the file. Try again.
READER.DOWNLOAD_ERROR: We could not prepare the download. Try again.

ERROR.NOT_CURRENT: A new version was published while you were reading. Refresh the document, read it and accept it again.
ERROR.ALREADY_ACCEPTED: You already accepted this version. Refresh the document to see its status.
ERROR.NOT_REQUIRED: This document no longer requires acceptance. Refresh the document to see it.
ERROR.NOT_ASSIGNED: This document is no longer assigned to you.
ERROR.GENERIC: We could not record your acceptance. Try again.

LIST.EMPTY_BODY: Documents appear when the company has a service with a contracted framework.
